title: Bloop Stack
description: Drop goo creatures into a jar, merge matching pairs up eight tiers to the Kingloop, and don't let the pile cross the line.

title: Tidy Tiles
description: Drag tile shapes onto an 8x8 grid and clear full rows and columns. A new daily puzzle with a twist, plus an endless mode.

title: Tray Disaster
description: Tilt a waiter's tray to keep a growing stack of absurd dishes balanced down the diner aisle while hazards jostle it. Game over is the bill.
